item.title: Richer data improve predictions of T cell receptor binding to specific antigens
item.content:encoded:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 23 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01109-3

We introduce Hi-TPH, a large-scale hierarchical dataset with more complete molecular sequences for predicting T cell receptor–antigen binding. Protein language models trained on Hi-TPH outperform existing tools on an external experimental benchmark and reveal how molecular components jointly contribute to binding prediction performance.
